name: Side Chat
description: A project-scoped sidebar chat that follows the current session and can return replies to the main input without sending.

en.name: Side Chat
en.description: A project-scoped sidebar chat that follows the current session and can return replies to the main input without sending.
en.safetyNotes: All sidebar messages use separate read-only Plan sessions. Local source references are exact-file allowlisted and still require native host authorization; originals are not copied. Office/TIFF parsing uses fs.read on a user-selected directory. Pathless files and converted pages are still stored, without a cumulative cache-size quota. File intake is limited to 500 MB and 10 files/outputs; decoding budgets still apply. This is not an OS sandbox; main access remains optional context and draft-only return.

zh-CN.name: 侧边聊天
zh-CN.description: 按项目保存历史的侧边聊天：自动跟随当前会话，可将回复放回主输入框，不自动发送。
zh-CN.safetyNotes: 全部侧聊由独立只读 Plan 会话承接。源路径仅允许登记的具体文件，仍受宿主授权约束，不复制原件；Office/TIFF 经 fs.read 读取用户选择目录。无源路径文件及转换图片仍需存储，不设累计缓存容量门槛。单文件500 MB、每次10个文件/输出，解码预算仍保留。并非 OS 沙箱；主会话仅可选背景和主动回填草稿。

author: VastSa
changelog: Release 0.1.18: allow files up to 500 MB and up to 10 files/converted outputs per send; remove the conflicting 20 MB cumulative queue/cache quota. Keep source references copy-free, preserve pathless inputs and existing history, and retain decoded-content budgets and native read-only authorization.
safetyNotes: Independent Plan sessions restrict reads to cached attachments and exact registered source files. Native authorization applies. fs.read only parses Office/TIFF under a user-selected root. Source originals are not copied; pathless inputs and converted pages still require storage with no cumulative cache quota. The 500 MB/10-file intake limits do not override decoding or model budgets. No automatic main-session sending; not an OS sandbox.
